featuredProjects.title: AI 3D Courtroom Simulator
featuredProjects.subtitle: Practise advocacy before the real trial.
featuredProjects.description: A proposed browser-based 3D courtroom where law students practise oral advocacy against an AI Judge, Opposing Counsel and 12 virtual jurors, with arguments evaluated through speech processing and language models.

featuredProjects.title: MoodWave
featuredProjects.subtitle: Music that meets your mood.
featuredProjects.description: A mood-based music recommendation experience, blending a streaming-inspired interface with music discovery, genre filtering and playback.

featuredProjects.title: Traffic Sign Detection
featuredProjects.subtitle: Smarter recognition through AI.
featuredProjects.description: A CNN-based traffic sign classifier trained on the GTSRB dataset, with a Streamlit interface for interactive image predictions across 43 sign classes.

featuredProjects.title: Cancer Research · ML Regression
featuredProjects.subtitle: Understanding data with care.
featuredProjects.description: A machine-learning regression study comparing feature-selection approaches, with learning curves, correlation analysis and actual-versus-predicted visualisations.

featuredProjects.title: Waste Classification
featuredProjects.subtitle: Sorting trash with transfer learning.
featuredProjects.description: An image classifier that sorts waste into six categories using ResNet18 transfer learning and data augmentation, reaching 83.95% test accuracy and a 0.8047 Matthews Correlation Coefficient.

featuredProjects.title: Handwritten Digit Recognition
featuredProjects.subtitle: Teaching networks to read numbers.
featuredProjects.description: Neural network architectures compared on MNIST and evaluated with accuracy, macro F1 and Matthews Correlation Coefficient, with a baseline model reaching 95.13% test accuracy.

featuredProjects.title: Local AI Academic Assistant
featuredProjects.subtitle: Private answers, running on my own machine.
featuredProjects.description: A locally hosted academic question-answering assistant built for a Deep Learning assignment, exploring local LLM deployment and inference with Ollama and Qwen3 1.7B.

featuredProjects.title: Movie Recommendation System
featuredProjects.subtitle: Discovery driven by preferences.
featuredProjects.description: A web-based movie recommendation project where audiences can browse genre-based listings, ratings and feedback through a MySQL-backed experience.

featuredProjects.title: Frontend Design Lab
featuredProjects.subtitle: Small interactions, better experiences.
featuredProjects.description: A collection of HTML, CSS and JavaScript experiments developed for frontend internship assignments, including interface-focused mini projects.

featuredProjects.title: Fantasy Car Showroom
featuredProjects.subtitle: An exploration in C++.
featuredProjects.description: A car-showroom themed programming project shared publicly on GitHub, representing hands-on C++ learning and problem solving.
